description: smb-mount-healer operator (Go, smb_mount_healer_* metrics): worker probes of SMB CSI mounts on every node, control-plane remediations (SmbMountRemediation), quarantined shadow data and host actions.

panels.description: Control-plane pods exporting smb_mount_healer_build_info. 0 = nothing remediates (alert SmbMountHealerControlPlaneAbsent).
panels.title: Control plane

panels.description: Worker DaemonSet pods (one per node) exporting smb_mount_healer_build_info. Should equal the number of nodes with SMB volumes.
panels.title: Workers reporting

panels.description: smb_mount_healer_dry_run of the control plane. Dry run: remediations walk every stage with outcome dry_run and host tasks are DryRun; nothing is scaled, deleted, unmounted or quarantined.
panels.title: Mode

panels.description: Mounts whose debounced health is Broken (confirmed dead CIFS, wrong fstype or not a mountpoint). The control plane starts a remediation for these.
panels.title: Broken mounts

panels.description: Mounts with a failed probe that are still being rechecked (debounce). Most clear up as false alarms.
panels.title: Suspect mounts

panels.description: SmbMountRemediation episodes currently in a non-terminal stage (kubectl get smbr).
panels.title: Active remediations

panels.description: Remediations that ended with outcome healed in the selected time range (filtered by $mode).
panels.title: Healed in range

panels.description: Remediations that ended without healing (verify_failed, rolled_back, failed, skipped_no_owner) in the selected time range. Each one fires SmbMountHealerRemediationFailed in live mode.
panels.title: Failed in range

panels.description: Quarantine folders (SmbQuarantine objects) holding data written to node-local disk while a mount was dead. They need manual recovery (kubectl get smbq).
panels.title: Pending quarantines

panels.description: Probe children stuck in the kernel (D-state) on a dead CIFS mount. They clear once the mount is force-unmounted.
panels.title: Hung probes

panels.description: Current debounced health of every SMB mount the workers probe. kind=pod is a pod's volume mount, kind=globalmount the node's CSI staging mount (no workload).
panels.title: Mount status

panels.description: Debounced health per mount over time: green Healthy, yellow Suspect (rechecking), orange Errored (probe machinery failed, never remediated), red Broken (remediation follows), grey Unknown.

targets.expr:
max by (node, kind, pv, workload) (
    (smb_mount_healer_mount_status{status="Broken",node=~"$node",workload_namespace=~"$workload_namespace"} == 1) * 3
 or (smb_mount_healer_mount_status{status="Errored",node=~"$node",workload_namespace=~"$workload_namespace"} == 1) * 2
 or (smb_mount_healer_mount_status{status="Suspect",node=~"$node",workload_namespace=~"$workload_namespace"} == 1) * 1
 or (smb_mount_healer_mount_status{status="Healthy",node=~"$node",workload_namespace=~"$workload_namespace"} == 1) * 0
 or (smb_mount_healer_mount_status{status="Unknown",node=~"$node",workload_namespace=~"$workload_namespace"} == 1) * -1
)

panels.title: Health per mount

panels.description: Debounced health transitions per 5m, by target state. Spikes of Suspect without Broken are blips the debounce absorbed.
panels.title: Health transitions

panels.description: Mounts that went Suspect and recovered on recheck without a remediation, by the probe failure reason. This is the debounce at work.
panels.title: False alarms by reason

panels.description: SmbMount objects across the cluster by health, as seen by the control plane (kubectl get smbm).
panels.title: SmbMount objects by health

panels.description: Stage of each active SmbMountRemediation (one row per node, type and stage). The row disappears when the episode reaches done.
panels.title: Active remediation stage per node

panels.description: Finished remediations per 5m by outcome (filtered by $mode). Anything but healed/dry_run needs a look at kubectl get smbr.
panels.title: Remediation outcomes

panels.description: Remediations created per 5m. Workload = scale down, unstage, restart driver, scale up; Sweep = clean orphaned dirs without touching workloads.
panels.title: Remediations started by type

panels.description: Remediation triggers the control plane did not act on: backoff (recent remediation on the node), scope_conflict (overlapping workloads already in an episode), active_remediation.
panels.title: Suppressed triggers by reason

panels.description: Actions on workloads per 5m by action and result (filtered by $mode): scale_down, scale_reassert, scale_up, driver_restart, rollback.
panels.title: Workload actions

panels.description: Post-remediation checks that each scaled-up workload mounts the share again: verified, elsewhere (rescheduled to another node), failed.
panels.title: Workload verifications

panels.description: 95th percentile time spent in each remediation stage over the selected range. Long awaiting_unstage means kubelet is slow to unstage (a pod still pins the volume).
panels.title: Stage duration p95 (range)

panels.description: p50 and p95 of whole-episode duration by outcome over the selected range. EPISODE_MAX_DURATION (default 30m) forces a rollback.
panels.title: Remediation duration by outcome (range)

panels.description: Non-terminal remediations picked up again after a control-plane restart or leader change. Expected after rollouts; frequent resumes mean the control plane is crash-looping.
panels.title: Resumed episodes (range)

panels.description: Remediation stage transitions in the selected range, with the reason recorded on each edge.
panels.title: Stage transitions (range)

panels.description: Quarantine folders per node and PV: data written to node-local disk while the mount was dead. Recover it from <kubeletRoot>/smb-mount-healer-quarantine/<folder>; the SmbQuarantine disappears once the folder is moved away or empty.

targets.expr: max by (node, pv) (smb_mount_healer_quarantine_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (node, pv) (smb_mount_healer_quarantines > 0))
time() - max by (node, pv) (smb_mount_healer_quarantine_oldest_timestamp_seconds{node=~"$node"} and on (node, pv) (smb_mount_healer_quarantines > 0))

panels.title: Pending quarantines

panels.description: Host actions the workers executed for SmbHostTasks per 5m, by action (force_unmount, quarantine, probe_now) and result (succeeded, skipped, dry_run, failed).
panels.title: Host actions

panels.description: Bytes held in quarantine folders per node and PV. Should drop to zero once someone recovered the data.
panels.title: Quarantine bytes

panels.description: Failed scans of the quarantine directory per 5m. Errors keep the SmbQuarantine objects stale.
panels.title: Quarantine scan errors

panels.description: 95th percentile duration of a single mount probe. Healthy CIFS answers in milliseconds; seconds mean the storage box is slow, STAT_TIMEOUT (5s) means it is gone.
panels.title: Check duration p95 by kind

panels.description: Mount probes per second by result: ok, not_mountpoint, wrong_fstype, stat_error, stat_timeout, probe_hung, probe_error.
panels.title: Check results

panels.description: Probe children stuck in D-state per node. A non-zero line that does not clear means a dead mount nobody has force-unmounted.
panels.title: Hung probes

panels.description: Failed server-side applies of SmbMount status by the workers per 5m. Persistent errors mean the control plane works on stale health.
panels.title: SmbMount status-write errors

panels.description: Globalmount directories whose hash matches no known SMB PV (leftovers of deleted PVs).
panels.title: Unknown globalmounts

panels.description: smb_mount_healer_build_info per component and node. All pods should run the same version after a rollout.
panels.title: Versions

panels.description: controller-runtime reconcile errors per second by controller, both components. Filtered on the PodMonitor job (namespace/name containing smb-mount-healer).
panels.title: Reconcile errors

panels.description: controller-runtime workqueue depth by queue name. A queue that keeps growing means a controller cannot keep up.
panels.title: Workqueue depth

list.description: Nodes with a running worker. Control-plane series are filtered on target_node with the same value.
list.label: Node
list.name: node

list.description: Namespace of the workload owning the mount (empty for globalmounts).
list.label: Namespace
list.name: workload_namespace

list.description: Remediation mode label: live (enforcing) or dry_run.
list.label: Mode
list.name: mode

title: SMB Mount Healer
